summary: Grab Holdings filed a 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and a raised full-year outlook. The release discloses that Grab repurchased $400 million of shares during September and October 2026, leaving $500 million remaining under its existing buyback program. No price per share, premium, or tender mechanics were stated; repurchases appear to have been executed in the open market. Q3 revenue rose 27% year over year to $1,112 million and adjusted EBITDA reached a record $237 million. Watch for further buyback execution pace and share-count reduction.
